## Design compliance

For UI/design/mockup changes:

- [ ] Read `DESIGN.md`.
- [ ] Read `design/tokens.md`.
- [ ] Checked latest relevant entries in `design/CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Used `design/manifest.json` to find relevant component/page specs.
- [ ] Ran `bun run design:manifest` if lookup/status/mock metadata changed.
- [ ] Ran or considered `bun run design:check`.
- [ ] Updated mockup routes/screenshots when visual behavior changed.
- [ ] Added a `design/CHANGELOG.md` entry with future agent action.
